ModMetaData.name: RimMT Clean Pathfinding A2.4 - Endpoint Only

ModMetaData.description: Narrow endpoint compatibility only. FinishFrame attachment Toils use Touch consistently for movement and construction checks. The former PathFinder cost kernel, glow and terrain caches, room queue, per-cell telemetry, and Root_Play update patch are retired.
